dynamic_feed.cache_policy: frontend should append bundle_version or timestamp cache-buster when Nathan requests a live refresh

frontend_contract: Fetch latest.json before rendering editorial state.
Fetch story-index.json and use each story's route/text_href/text_state fields.
When text_href is present, title and byline should link to /stories/<slug>/.
The story route fetches the referenced story JSON and renders display_text as OCR-derived provisional text, with source/facsimile controls visible.
Do not hide a story merely because text is provisional; label the text state compactly.
If backend fetch fails, keep the packaged site snapshot and report fallback state on /reconstruction-status/.
Show backend version/built timestamp on /reconstruction-status/ so tunnel health is visible.

style.case_rule: Keep the publication styling lowercase in site chrome and project labels.
